typography.primary_font: Tajawal, Cairo, or IBM Plex Sans Arabic
typography.headings: Bold (700) or ExtraBold (800) with tight tracking (tracking-tight). Use dark slate (#0F172A).

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-xl or rounded-2xl for a friendly yet professional app feel.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Group hover effects to transition border color to primary and slight translateY (-translate-y-1). Duration 200ms ease-out.

concepts_to_build.name: Bento Grid (شبكة بينتو غير المتماثلة)
concepts_to_build.description: Asymmetrical grid where high-priority modules (Students, Courses) take up more space (col-span-2 row-span-2). Creates visual hierarchy and tension.
concepts_to_build.card_style: Solid white, 1px border. Large icons. Important cards have bottom-aligned text, smaller cards are centered.

concepts_to_build.name: Metric-Driven Cards (البطاقات التحليلية والتفاعلية)
concepts_to_build.description: Dense grid where each card acts as a shortcut AND a live metric display (e.g., '1,200 Students'). Highly functional for admins.
concepts_to_build.layout_classes: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
concepts_to_build.card_style: White surface, neumorphic subtle shadow. Top row: Icon & Status. Bottom row: Title & Big Metric.

concepts_to_build.name: Categorized Swimlanes (مسارات أفقية حسب الفئة)
concepts_to_build.description: Modules are grouped by category (Academic, Administrative, Reports). Each category is a horizontal scrollable list, avoiding grid overload.
concepts_to_build.layout_classes: flex flex-col gap-8 (parent), flex overflow-x-auto gap-4 pb-4 (swimlane)
concepts_to_build.card_style: Compact cards (w-64 shrink-0). Color-coded borders/backgrounds based on category.

concepts_to_build.name: App Icon Grid (شبكة التطبيقات المبسطة)
concepts_to_build.description: Inspired by iOS/macOS home screens. Perfect square cards, huge centered icons, minimalistic text. Highly touch-friendly.
concepts_to_build.layout_classes: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-6
concepts_to_build.card_style: Aspect-square. backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70. Centered content. Icon is wrapped in a soft colored circle.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user explicitly requested to 'Suggest 3-4 concepts/shapes to choose from before building the actual logic'.
DO NOT build the final application logic or API integrations. Instead, build a React 'Showcase / Gallery' component that presents these 4 dashboard concepts beautifully on one page.
Use a Tabs component (from shadcn/ui) or stacked sections so the user can switch between Concept 1, Concept 2, Concept 3, and Concept 4 to evaluate them.
Use dummy Arabic data for the permissions (المقررات، الطلاب، المعلمين، الخطة الدراسية، تبادل المحاضرات، أعذار الطلاب، سلة المحذوفات).
Ensure `dir="rtl"` is applied either on the main container or html tag. Use Tailwind logical properties if possible (e.g., `ms-4`, `pe-2`) or ensure correct Arabic alignment.
Use `lucide-react` for icons (Users, BookOpen, GraduationCap, Calendar, FileText, Settings, Trash2).
Make it fully responsive so the user can test how concepts look on mobile vs desktop.
Include a title for the showcase page (مثال: 'مقترحات تصميم لوحة تحكم الصلاحيات') and a brief Arabic description for each concept.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Make the cards feel premium with exact padding, crisp borders, and refined text hierarchy.
DO NOT use a transparent background over elements that have scrolling content under them. If headers/navs exist, give them solid or high-opacity glass backgrounds.
DO NOT apply `transition-all` blindly. Target specific properties (e.g., `transition-transform transition-colors`).
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="concept-tab-1"`).
For RTL, alignment of icons and text is critical. If an icon is next to text, the icon should be on the right, and text on the left of the icon. Check flex directions.
Use Tailwind CSS strictly for styling. If using Shadcn UI, adapt them to the Arabic RTL context.
